problems.quote: Stable isotope tracers (δ¹⁸O, δD) confirm that the affected groundwater is modern recharge with a residence time of decades.
problems.problem: Stable isotopes (δ¹⁸O, δD) indicate recharge source and evaporation but cannot directly quantify residence time; residence time requires tracers such as tritium/helium or carbon-14.
problems.correction: Stable isotopes (δ¹⁸O, δD) indicate modern recharge; residence times of decades are determined by tracers like ³H/³He.
problems.verifierReason: Original misstates that δ¹⁸O, δD give residence time; correction correctly limits them to source indication and cites appropriate tracers.
